metadata.record_unit: One provisional golf facility entry with nested course details. Verified groups are explicitly marked; unreviewed source entries may still belong to the same facility. Facility holes are a supported total, never an assumed division into eighteen-hole layouts.
metadata.public_access_basis: Explicit public classification, primary-source public/nonmember play offer, or an applicable tourism-directory inclusion criterion explicitly requiring public golf. Conflicting or unverified access remains excluded.
metadata.address_basis: Published course or mailing address; city-only listings remain null. Not a verified driving entrance.
metadata.freshness: Sources reviewed during compilation beginning October 6, 2026. Source publication dates are often unknown; indexed and older evidence is noted where material. updated_on is the compilation date, not a fresh verification of every row. No claim of real-time operating status.
metadata.county_basis: County supported by a Census batch Exact flag plus matching normalized street/city/state (ZIP-only correction allowed), a single-address Census result with matching normalized full street/city/state/five-digit-ZIP, or an explicit primary-source county statement. This identifies the address geography, not the entire course footprint. Missing or ambiguous matches remain null.
metadata.rights: Bare facts and explicitly licensed source attributes with citations. No source prose, photographs, map geometry or scorecard artwork included. Applicable source-data licenses and adaptations are recorded below.

source_licenses.applies_to: Records citing gis.utah.gov or the UtahAGRC GolfCourses feature service
source_licenses.changes: Selected Public/Municipal records; omitted geometry and unrelated attributes; normalized names; added independently sourced addresses; corrected documented legacy names and holes; withheld ambiguous records.

metadata.course_details_basis: Nested courses require explicit retained evidence of the physical layout; a facility total alone never establishes a single course or a division into courses, including totals of nine or eighteen. Unknown subdivisions remain an empty list. A null course name is permitted for an explicitly established physical layout without a separately established layout label, including a component of a multi-course facility. course_details_complete concerns established physical layouts and their physical hole counts, not the availability of separate layout labels or national completeness. Optional course address/county overrides apply only when independently verified.
metadata.county_evidence_basis: county_evidence records retained accepted Census address matches. Entries with method census_exact_address use the batch Exact flag plus normalized street, city and state agreement, with a ZIP-only correction permitted. Entries with method census_normalized_full_address use a single-address result with matching normalized full street, city, state and five-digit ZIP; no batch Exact flag is asserted for that method. The matched address, county FIPS, method and observed_on identify the retained result; benchmark and geography vintage are recorded in county_source. This is address geography, not the entire course footprint or a verified entrance. An absent county_evidence object means that no field-specific retained match is published here, not a new verification of a historical county value. The approved reviewed batches observed on 2026-10-10 additionally required five-digit ZIP agreement without correction; their batch_id values distinguish these stricter accepted matches.
metadata.website_basis: Official course/operator URLs from explicitly retained owner identity or an inspected directory Website field. Inspected operator mappings take precedence over older directory website fields; source-list order alone does not determine the website. Unknown or conflicting identities remain null; no exhaustive new site visits.
metadata.coordinate_basis: Coordinates are retained Census address-range estimates for strictly accepted public street-address matches, not verified course entrances, centroids, survey locations or routing destinations. Null means no qualifying retained coordinate evidence.
metadata.source_review_status: Source-history audit in progress. Known New Hampshire and Agawam post-hold source contributions have been removed, two Memphis owner-derived hole counts withheld, seven Montana association citations with unresolved chronology removed and unsupported hole counts cleared, three Monroe facilities rebased on retained independent operator evidence with unsupported fields cleared, and a stale Wilkes-Barre website cleared. This is not a comprehensive source-policy clearance; further audit corrections may follow.
